distinct_mechanism: Unsigned native tick activity partitions each day into endogenous observations. A three-state Gaussian hidden Markov model learns the persistence of price impact and arrival tempo; its posterior transition-implied next-bucket impact drives autonomous new market entries. It is not the closed Cross signed four-hour return regressor, a new Cross hour/threshold, a score on accepted old trades, an exit overlay, or a price-direction-change event rule.
replacement_scope: Only original Passive entry/exit engine is replaced in its own candidate. The new engine is an intraday activity-clock signal with a one-slot position, next-bucket or bounded time exit. This is one inseparable new strategy law, not a rescue of old Passive execution parameters.
closed_neighborhoods: No old candidate source/model/weights/state or selected path seeds this campaign. No adjacent activity threshold, state count, feature, learning step, emission law, time window, symbol, hold, hurdle or risk follow-up after closure.
